description: This PHP source file 'reqView.php' is part of the TestLink open source project. It handles the display and management of requirements view, initialization of page objects, user rights checks, and related operations within the requirements module.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for handling requirement operations such as retrieval, history, and attachments.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class representing test project details and operations.

classes.name: reqCommands
classes.description: Class managing requirement-related command operations, including GUI initialization.
